source_caption:
They’re always getting themselves into the wildest situations. 😂

Minions & Monsters is an upcoming animated comedy from Illumination, arriving in theaters on July 1, 2026. The story follows the Minions as they accidentally unleash monsters across early Hollywood while trying to make a movie, forcing them to team up and save the world.

Directed by Pierre Coffin, the film features the voices of Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, and Jeff Bridges, with a score by John Powell. Fans can also expect plenty of the Minions’ signature Minionese throughout the film.

source_details.synopsis: Minions & Monsters is a 2026 American animated period comedy film directed by Pierre Coffin, who co-wrote the screenplay with Brian Lynch. Produced by Universal Pictures and Illumination, it is the third installment in the Minions prequel series and the seventh overall installment in the Despicable Me franchise. The film stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Trey Parker, Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jesse Eisenberg, Jeff Bridges, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan and Phil LaMarr. Taking place in 1927, between silent film and sound film, 41 years before the events of Minions (2015), the film follows a group of Minions as they aim to make a monster movie of their own in Old Hollywood.
